dimensions: external side effects and their publication order
algorithm: tag every read and write with session identity and transaction mode

place the competing user action after the decisive read
first make all operations share one session

name: Lift a proven frontier violation into its highest feasible irreversible consumer

payload.starting_point: a lower-level RED proves a frontier, owner, generation, or retention promise can be violated
algorithm: enumerate consumers that validate the frontier once and later revoke cleanup or publish state
identify the gap between validation and revocation/publication
place the irreversible producer in that gap
rank consumers by user terminal severity
keep the lower oracle for cheap root detection and the higher consumer for severity proof
terminal_ranking: successful user operation with missing durable data
negative_screens: cleanup task removal and external deletion share one atomic owner
the alleged loss is only an obsolete snapshot with no supported consumer

name: Large FLASHBACK DATABASE overlaps one due periodic GC prepare

payload.production_story: An operator starts FLASHBACK DATABASE for a dropped database near a scheduled GC round. Recovery disables GC and validates the old stored safe point. requires: flashback passes the old safe-point check
recovery remains in progress until GC loads delete ranges
